docs.title: Welcome to unicef-security documentation
docs.text: unicef-security is a Django app that provides a custom user model and other security-related features for UNICEF applications.

docs.title: Core Features
docs.text:
• Custom User Model: A custom user model that extends Django's AbstractUser with fields for Azure Active Directory integration.
  • Azure AD Integration: Integration with Azure Active Directory for authentication and user synchronization.
  • Admin Customizations: Customizations for the Django admin interface to manage users and their Azure AD data.
  • Social Authentication Pipeline: A social authentication pipeline for creating and updating users from Azure AD.

docs.title: Models
docs.text:
The unicef-security app provides two models:

  • SecurityMixin: A mixin model that adds security-related fields to the user model. These fields are used to store user data from Azure Active Directory, such as the user's Azure AD ID, job title, and display name.
  • TimeStampedModel: A model that adds a last_modify_date field to other models.

docs.title: Admin
docs.text: The unicef-security app provides a custom user admin.

docs.title: UserAdminPlus
docs.text: A custom user admin that adds extra buttons and filters.

docs.title: Buttons
docs.text:
• sync_user: Synchronizes a user with Azure Active Directory.
  • link_user_data: Links a user to an Azure Active Directory account.
  • load: Loads users from Azure Active Directory.
  • ad: Shows a user's Azure Active Directory data.

docs.title: Filters
docs.text: • UNICEFUserFilter: Filters users by whether they are UNICEF users or external users.

docs.title: Backends
docs.text: The unicef-security app provides custom authentication backends.

docs.title: UNICEFAzureADTenantOAuth2Ext
docs.text: An extension of social_core.backends.azuread_tenant.AzureADTenantOAuth2 that adds support for UNICEF's Azure Active Directory tenant.

docs.title: Methods
docs.text: • user_data: Decodes the ID token and returns the user data.

docs.title: Graph API
docs.text: The unicef-security app provides a client for interacting with the Microsoft Graph API.

docs.title: Synchronizer
docs.text: A class for synchronizing users with Azure Active Directory.

docs.title: Methods
docs.text:
• get_token: Gets an access token from Azure Active Directory.
  • get_page: Gets a page of users from Azure Active Directory.
  • get_record: Gets a user record from Azure Active Directory.
  • fetch_users: Fetches users from Azure Active Directory.
  • search_users: Searches for users in Azure Active Directory.
  • filter_users_by_email: Filters users by email in Azure Active Directory.
  • get_user: Gets a user from Azure Active Directory.
  • sync_user: Synchronizes a user with Azure Active Directory.
  • resume: Resumes a synchronization with Azure Active Directory.
  • is_valid: Checks if a user is valid.
  • synchronize: Synchronizes users with Azure Active Directory.

docs.title: Middleware
docs.text: The unicef-security app provides custom middleware for handling social authentication exceptions.

docs.title: UNICEFSocialAuthExceptionMiddleware
docs.text: Middleware that handles exceptions during social authentication.

docs.title: Methods
docs.text:
• process_exception: Processes exceptions that occur during social authentication.
  • get_redirect_uri: Returns the redirect URI for the user.

docs.title: Models
docs.text: The unicef-security app provides a custom user model and other security-related models.

docs.title: SecurityMixin
docs.text: A mixin model that adds security-related fields to the user model.

docs.title: Fields
docs.text:
• azure_id (UUIDField): The user's Azure Active Directory ID.
  • job_title (CharField): The user's job title.
  • display_name (CharField): The user's display name.

docs.title: Properties
docs.text: • label: A cached property that returns the user's display name, full name, or username.

docs.title: TimeStampedModel
docs.text: A model that adds a last_modify_date field.

docs.title: Fields
docs.text: • last_modify_date (DateTimeField): The date and time the model was last modified.

docs.title: Pipeline
docs.text: The unicef-security app provides custom social authentication pipeline functions.

docs.title: social_details
docs.text: A pipeline function that adds the user's IDP to the details.

docs.title: get_username
docs.text: A pipeline function that gets the user's username from their email address.

docs.title: create_unicef_user
docs.text: A pipeline function that creates a UNICEF user.

docs.title: user_details
docs.text: A pipeline function that updates the user's details.

docs.title: Utils
docs.text: The unicef-security app provides utility functions.

docs.title: get_setting
docs.text: A function that gets a setting from a list of possible settings.

docs.title: Views
docs.text: The unicef-security app provides views for handling authorization and authentication.

docs.title: UnauthorizedView
docs.text: A view that is displayed when a user is not authorized to access a page.

docs.title: Context
docs.text: • unicef_user (bool): Whether the user is a UNICEF user.

docs.title: UNICEFLogoutView
docs.text: A view that logs the user out of their UNICEF account.
